intent: Polish the object quick-view drawer so it reads as a cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud object inspector rather than a generic prototype side panel.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added dynamic and SSR-static object proof strip to SidePeek, tying selected objects to FD-001 workload evidence, Oyatie Cloud cell-us-east-2, REC-WF-7741, and local-only state.
Upgraded the evidence trail copy to include FD-001 workload, Oyatie Cloud rollback, and REC-WF-7741 receipt context.
Converted generic SidePeek buttons into data-bound local actions for owner assignment, Messenger note drafting, and evidence review.
Added object proof route buttons for workload graph, cloud cell, and evidence receipt with selected state, hash routing, activity feed feedback, and visible status updates.
Added reusable CSS for the proof card, route grid, selected action states, and responsive SidePeek behavior using existing command-surface tokens.

visual_verdict.category_match: Cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud object inspector drawer
visual_verdict.reasoning: The object quick view now reads as a product-grade FD-001/Oyatie Cloud inspector with explicit object proof, evidence receipt, cloud cell, local-only boundary, and interactive routes/actions.
differences: The drawer remains visual-only and does not assign owners, send messages, execute workflows, or mutate cloud state by design.
suggestions: Future wiring can bind SidePeek actions to real object graph, owner assignment, messenger draft, and evidence review APIs.

commands.summary: ready-after-4s; transient empty replies immediately after restart

known_limits: Visual prototype only; object inspector actions do not persist owner assignment, send messages, execute workflows, mutate audit receipts, or mutate cloud/provider state.
This slice improves the SidePeek object inspector; it does not prove the full dashboard/mockup objective complete.
